purpose: Real dataset sources for NearGuard validation. Raw files are not bundled because of size and licensing.

datasets.name: BDD100K
datasets.near_guard_use: Train/evaluate YOLO road-user detection for person, bicycle, car, motorcycle, bus and truck.
datasets.access_note: Manual registration/download may be required. Keep raw files outside the submitted ZIP.

datasets.name: MOT17
datasets.near_guard_use: Evaluate tracking ID stability across frames.
datasets.access_note: Public archive; useful for tracking, mainly pedestrians.

datasets.name: CityFlow / AI City Challenge
datasets.near_guard_use: Evaluate vehicle tracking in multi-camera city traffic settings.
datasets.access_note: Follow official AI City Challenge data instructions.

datasets.name: DoTA
datasets.near_guard_use: Compare candidate risky events against temporal and object-level anomaly annotations.
datasets.access_note: Use for research validation, not as a proof of deployed accuracy by itself.

datasets.name: A3D
datasets.near_guard_use: Study anomaly-detection evaluation and compare with dashcam scenarios.
datasets.access_note: Download through the authors' provided workflow and respect the source terms.

datasets.name: CADP
datasets.near_guard_use: CCTV-style validation reference for accident forecasting and small pedestrian detection difficulty.
datasets.access_note: Use dataset release instructions from the project page.
